name: Inovelli Blue Series 2-1 Switch (US)

matter.note: This is the Zigbee version. The Inovelli page also covers a Matter version, which is a different model; we found no Matter claim for the VZM31-SN.

apple_home.note: Inovelli's pages we saw don't mention Apple Home for the Zigbee version.

google_home.note: Inovelli's pages we saw don't mention Google Home for the Zigbee version.

alexa.via: Amazon Echo with built-in Zigbee hub
alexa.note: Inovelli lists Amazon Echo as a compatible hub, but only Echo versions with a built-in Zigbee hub (Inovelli keeps a compatibility chart). Firmware features such as multi-tap scenes work only where the hub supports them.

smartthings.note: Inovelli lists SmartThings among hubs that support the switch's advanced features and publishes a SmartThings setup guide.

home_assistant.note: Inovelli lists Home Assistant through ZHA and Zigbee2MQTT. Both are generic Zigbee integrations, not an Inovelli integration, and need a Zigbee coordinator such as a USB adapter.

hubRequired.note: Needs a Zigbee hub or coordinator (SmartThings, Hubitat, an Echo with Zigbee, or a USB adapter with Home Assistant).

localControl.note: Inovelli lists Home Assistant's ZHA, which controls Zigbee devices through a local coordinator with no cloud. Other hubs, such as an Echo, may route control differently.

switchForm.note: Replaces a wall switch; it can run as a dimmer or as an on/off switch.

dimmer.note: One switch with a dimmer or on/off mode.

neutralRequired.note: Works without a neutral, but Inovelli says a bypass must then be installed at the light fixture, and it isn't included. Without a neutral there is no energy monitoring, and multi-way setups need an Inovelli aux switch.

gangs.note: Not stated in the pages we saw; it works in single-pole and multi-way setups.

summary: Inovelli's Blue Series 2-1 (VZM31-SN) is a Zigbee wall switch that runs as a dimmer or an on/off switch. It works with or without a neutral, but without one you need a bypass that is not in the box. It needs a Zigbee hub: Inovelli lists SmartThings, Hubitat, Home Assistant (ZHA or Zigbee2MQTT) and supported Echo models. It supports multi-way setups with an aux switch.
caveats: Needs a Zigbee hub or coordinator; no direct Wi-Fi or Matter.
Without a neutral wire a bypass is required, and it isn't included.
Advanced features such as multi-tap scenes work only on hubs that support them; Inovelli names SmartThings, Hubitat and Home Assistant.
Apple Home and Google Home support is not documented by Inovelli for this version.
